# 08 · ASSETS, BUILD PHASES & QA — Torquewell Auto

## 1. Asset Table (all generated by the coding agent; nothing "TBD")
Registry: every asset has an entry in `assets/manifest.json` (`id, path, prompt, size, status, alt{en,hi}`). Use the **master image-prompt template** from File 02.
| Group | Files (naming) | Sizes | Notes / Procedural fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hero cinematic | `img/hero/hero-01…06.avif/.webp/.jpg` | 1920×1080 (+1200, 768) | Fallback: tread-line pattern + lime tick-scale SVG |
| Services | `img/services/{slug}.avif/.webp` (14) | 1200×1500 (+768, 480) | Fallback: duotone tile + line icon |
| Parts macros | `img/parts/{id}.avif/.webp` (8) | 1200×1200 | Fallback: CSS procedural metal/rubber textures |
| People portraits | `img/people/{id}.avif/.webp` (≈35) | 800×1000 (+400×500) | Fallback: initials in lug-nut ring; labelled "Fictional" |
| Branches/facilities | `img/branch/{id}.avif/.webp` (8) | 1200×800 | Fallback: gradient + icon |
| Journey stops | `img/journey/{stage}.avif/.webp` (9) | 1200×800 | Fallback: SVG vignette |
| Proof Report photos | `img/proof/{finding}-{n}.avif/.webp` (~24) | 1200×900 | Macro/hands-only, fictional car; fallback: annotated SVG |
| Generic car exploded set | `img/car/base.svg`, `layers/*.svg` (8 layers) | vector | Generic silhouette, no brand cues |
| Exploded views (Know Your Car) | `img/know/{slug}.svg` (20) | 1200×800 | Layered `<g>`; parts list JSON alongside |
| Bay plans | `img/bayplan-{branch}.svg` (3) | vector | Focusable `<path>` per bay |
| Road path (Mileage Map) | `img/road.svg` | vector | Single smooth path for `getPointAtLength` |
| Warning-light icons | `img/icons/lights/{id}.svg` (16) | 48px grid | **Original redraws**, not copies of OEM/ISO artwork |
| Icons | `img/icons/sprite.svg` (70) | 24px grid | Hand-authored SVG |
| Patterns/textures | `img/pattern/tread.svg`, `ticks.svg`, `grain.png` | 512 tile | Very low opacity |
| Accreditation placeholders | `img/accred/placeholder-{n}.svg` (4) | 600×400 | Clearly marked "PLACEHOLDER" |
| OG / social | `og/{page}.png` (5) | 1200×630 | SVG→PNG script with brand template |
| Fonts | `fonts/*.woff2` | subset | Familjen Grotesk (Bricolage fallback), Public Sans, DM Mono, Noto Sans Devanagari |
| Video (optional) | `video/wheel-torque.webm` | ≤ 700KB, 8s loop | Tier A only; poster required |
| PDF templates | `pdf/symptom-sheet.tsx`, `proof-report.tsx`, `estimate-breakdown.tsx`, `service-roadmap.tsx` | A4 | EN + HI |
| Mock documents | `docs-sample/{id}.pdf` (8) | ≤ 60KB each | Generated sample invoices/reports |
Rules: AVIF → WebP → JPEG; rasters within File 05 budgets; alt text always; generated people labelled fictional in privacy disclosure; **no vehicle-manufacturer badges, plates or real vehicles in any image**.

**Logo & favicon files:** `logo-primary.svg`, `logo-mark.svg`, `logo-mono-light.svg`, `logo-mono-dark.svg`, `logo-stacked.svg`, `logo-click.svg`, `favicon.ico`, `favicon.svg`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`, `maskable-512.png`, `site.webmanifest`, `safari-pinned-tab.svg`.

## 2. BUILD PHASES

### Phase 0 — SETUP ONLY (define exactly; then STOP and wait for "go")
1. Scaffold project (Vite + React + TS) and initialise **git**.
2. Install dependencies per File 06.
3. Initialise **Tailwind** and **shadcn/ui**.
4. Create **tokens** from File 02 (`tokens.css`, Tailwind mapping) — variables only.
5. Set up **self-hosted fonts** (files + `@font-face`, not applied visually).
6. Create the **folder structure** from File 06.
7. Fill `config/site.ts` from File 01.
8. Create `types.ts` from File 06 and `lib/units.ts` skeleton with unit tests.
9. **i18n skeleton** (en/hi namespaces, placeholder keys, `check:i18n`).
10. **Router with ALL routes from File 03** as minimal placeholder pages (route name only).
11. Minimal **layout shell** (unstyled header/main/footer landmarks).
12. Configure **ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, Playwright** (+ axe), Husky/lint-staged.
13. Add **scripts** from File 06 (`check:denylist` stub included).
14. **First git commit.**
15. Create stubs: `README.md`, `PROGRESS.md`, `SOURCES.md`, `assets/manifest.json`.
16. **Verify:** install ✔ · typecheck ✔ · lint ✔ · build ✔ · dev server boots ✔ · all routes resolve ✔.
> **Phase 0 contains NO real design, NO copy, NO images, NO animations.** Report results, update `PROGRESS.md`, then stop.

### Phase 1 — Foundation & Help-First
Design-system components, header/footer, Help-now and Book pills, consent gate, theme/language/units/Calm controls, **Help now page** (fast, offline-cached), safety line everywhere. *Exit:* Help reachable in 1 click on every route; a11y checks pass; units tested.

### Phase 2 — Brand & Home Hero
Logo/favicons, fonts applied, hero imagery, Home hero + route tiles, "Click-through" transitions, loader, cursor, scroll progress.

### Phase 3 — Symptom & Warning-Light Guide (highest utility)
Rule table, red-flag logic, warning-light icon set, results, Symptom Sheet PDF (EN/HI), tests for rules.

### Phase 4 — Drive-In to Drive-Out + Home story
Generic car SVG layers, GSAP story, static fallback, mobile tier.

### Phase 5 — Proof Report + Fair-Price Breakdown
Findings data, gauges, donut, photo carousel, parts-tier estimator, PDFs, "needed now" toggle.

### Phase 6 — Services, Service Menu & Booking
Data, listing/detail pages, packages compare, booking stepper (mock, .ics).

### Phase 7 — Bay Board + Mileage Map
Journey drawers, live board simulator + TV layout; road path map, milestones, Roadmap PDF/ICS.

### Phase 8 — Bay Crew, Locations & Careers
Bay plans, hierarchy + accessible tree, profiles, branches, careers.

### Phase 9 — Garage Portal
Portal shell, dashboard, logbook timeline, approvals, invoices, reminders, fleet tab, messages.

### Phase 10 — Know Your Car + EV & Fleet
20 articles (EN/HI) with exploded views, search, print styles, sources; EV & Hybrid and Fleet pages.

### Phase 11 — Remaining pages, Polish, Performance & QA
About, Policies, Contact, Legal, 404; motion polish; performance tuning to budgets; full a11y audit; cross-browser/device; SEO/JSON-LD; PWA; EN/HI proofreading; asset manifest completeness; `WALKTHROUGH_SCRIPT.md`.

## 3. Definition of Done
**Visual**
- [ ] Matches File 02 tokens/typography; both themes polished; no cliché imagery (chrome-and-flames, thumbs-up stock, red-black racing)
- [ ] Responsive at 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536, 1920 px; no horizontal scroll (tables scroll in containers)
- [ ] Every image has a fallback; no empty boxes; urgency never colour-only

**Function**
- [ ] All 8 signature features work per File 04 including edge cases
- [ ] Help-now and Book pills on every route; command palette covers all pages
- [ ] Unit toggle converts every measurement/price correctly (tests pass); language/theme/Calm/text-size persist
- [ ] PDFs render EN/HI (Symptom Sheet, Proof Report, Estimate Breakdown, Service Roadmap); print styles OK

**Content**
- [ ] No lorem/TBD; EN/HI parity (CI); all names, vehicles, plates, prices and records realistic and compliant
- [ ] Disclaimers present per File 01 §5.3; none of the forbidden claims/marks/reviews (File 01 §5.2); `check:denylist` passes
- [ ] `SOURCES.md` complete for every factual/technical claim; legal minimums shown as "varies by country"

**Performance / A11y / SEO**
- [ ] Lighthouse mobile: Perf ≥ 90, A11y ≥ 98, BP ≥ 95, SEO ≥ 95 on key pages
- [ ] LCP ≤ 2.0s (Help ≤ 1.2s), CLS ≤ 0.02, INP ≤ 150ms; JS budgets met
- [ ] WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard, focus visible, contrast, reduced motion, screen-reader checks, gauge/chart text alternatives
- [ ] JSON-LD valid; sitemap/robots/hreflang correct; SEO indexable

**Engineering**
- [ ] Typecheck/lint/unit/e2e/a11y green in CI; no console errors
- [ ] Guide and pricing tools make zero network calls (test asserts)
- [ ] No unused deps; bundle analysed; README complete; white-label swap tested (config change rebrands)

## 4. `WALKTHROUGH_SCRIPT.md` — 7-Minute Pitch Flow
| Time | Show | Say (intent) |
|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:30 | Home hero | "A worried driver lands here. Within seconds they know where to turn." (Help/Book pills visible) |
| 0:30–1:30 | Drive-In to Drive-Out | "Watch a car's whole visit — with evidence at every stage." |
| 1:30–2:45 | Symptom & Warning-Light Guide → Symptom Sheet | "Can I still drive it? Answered safely, and they leave with notes for any mechanic." |
| 2:45–4:00 | Proof Report + Fair-Price Breakdown | "See the worn part, the measurement, the price logic — choose with confidence." (toggle "needed now" and parts tier) |
| 4:00–5:00 | Mileage Map | "Plan ahead and know what can safely wait." (toggle km/mi) |
| 5:00–5:45 | Bay Board + Bay Crew | "Where's my car, and who's working on it." |
| 5:45–6:15 | Garage Portal + Know Your Car | "A logbook they keep, and explanations that make them smarter customers." |
| 6:15–6:45 | Language + theme + units + Calm + ⌘K | "Built for every driver, every market, every device." |
| 6:45–7:00 | Close: "Proof, not promises." | "All of this is config-driven and ready to become yours." |
**Backup plan:** if a feature fails live, jump via ⌘K to the next; keep an offline build ready.
